definitions.documentation:
Get Pipeline in the explicitly selected organization/project. Existing trigger/workflow pins and service hooks are unaffected. Actions require confirmWrites and no automatic retries.

GET /{organization}/{project}/_apis/pipelines/{pipelineId}. Read operation.

Inputs: organization (optional), project (optional), pipelineId (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, item. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://dev.azure.com), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Project-scoped Azure DevOps PAT/OAuth permission for the selected API. Basic PAT authentication; never logs credentials.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

Synthetic example inputs:

```json
{
  "organization": "sample-org",
  "project": "Synthetic Project",
  "pipelineId": 1
}
```

This example is documentation, not a run.

definitions.documentation:
List Builds in the explicitly selected organization/project. Existing trigger/workflow pins and service hooks are unaffected. Actions require confirmWrites and no automatic retries.

GET /{organization}/{project}/_apis/build/builds. Read operation.

Inputs: organization (optional), project (optional), statusFilter (optional), continuation (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, items, count, has_more, continuation. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://dev.azure.com), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Project-scoped Azure DevOps PAT/OAuth permission for the selected API. Basic PAT authentication; never logs credentials.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). Follow bounded provider continuation or pass continuation to fetch the next page. has_more reports an unconsumed continuation. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

```json
{
  "organization": "sample-org",
  "project": "Synthetic Project",
  "statusFilter": "sample"
}
```

definitions.documentation:
Get Pipeline Run in the explicitly selected organization/project. Existing trigger/workflow pins and service hooks are unaffected. Actions require confirmWrites and no automatic retries.

GET /{organization}/{project}/_apis/pipelines/{pipelineId}/runs/{runId}. Read operation.

Inputs: organization (optional), project (optional), pipelineId (optional), runId (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, item, run_id, run_state, run_result. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://dev.azure.com), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Project-scoped Azure DevOps PAT/OAuth permission for the selected API. Basic PAT authentication; never logs credentials.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

```json
{
  "organization": "sample-org",
  "project": "Synthetic Project",
  "pipelineId": 1,
  "runId": 1
}
```

definitions.documentation:
List Pipelines in the explicitly selected organization/project. Existing trigger/workflow pins and service hooks are unaffected. Actions require confirmWrites and no automatic retries.

GET /{organization}/{project}/_apis/pipelines. Read operation.

Inputs: organization (optional), project (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, items, count, has_more, continuation. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://dev.azure.com), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Project-scoped Azure DevOps PAT/OAuth permission for the selected API. Basic PAT authentication; never logs credentials.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

```json
}
```

definitions.name: Azure DevOps Run Pipeline
definitions.description: Run Pipeline in the explicitly selected organization/project. Existing trigger/workflow pins and service hooks are unaffected. Actions require confirmWrites and no automatic retries.
definitions.documentation:
Run Pipeline in the explicitly selected organization/project. Existing trigger/workflow pins and service hooks are unaffected. Actions require confirmWrites and no automatic retries.

POST /{organization}/{project}/_apis/pipelines/{pipelineId}/runs. External write action; set confirmWrites=true and $retries=0 deliberately.

Inputs: organization (optional), project (optional), pipelineId (optional), branch (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, item. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://dev.azure.com), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Project-scoped Azure DevOps PAT/OAuth permission for the selected API. Basic PAT authentication; never logs credentials.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

Synthetic example inputs:

```json
{
  "organization": "sample-org",
  "project": "Synthetic Project",
  "pipelineId": 1,
  "branch": "refs/heads/main"
}
```

This example is documentation, not a run. 

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/devops/pipelines/runs/run-pipeline?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1

definitions.documentation:
Queue Build in the explicitly selected organization/project. Existing trigger/workflow pins and service hooks are unaffected. Actions require confirmWrites and no automatic retries.

POST /{organization}/{project}/_apis/build/builds. External write action; set confirmWrites=true and $retries=0 deliberately.

Inputs: organization (optional), project (optional), definitionId (optional), sourceBranch (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, item. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://dev.azure.com), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Project-scoped Azure DevOps PAT/OAuth permission for the selected API. Basic PAT authentication; never logs credentials.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

Synthetic example inputs:

```json
{
  "organization": "sample-org",
  "project": "Synthetic Project",
  "definitionId": 1,
  "sourceBranch": "refs/heads/main"
}
```

This example is documentation, not a run.

definitions.documentation:
List Azure DevOps Projects in the explicitly selected organization/project. Existing trigger/workflow pins and service hooks are unaffected. Actions require confirmWrites and no automatic retries.

GET /{organization}/_apis/projects. Read operation.

Inputs: organization (optional), continuation (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, items, count, has_more, continuation. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://dev.azure.com), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Project-scoped Azure DevOps PAT/OAuth permission for the selected API. Basic PAT authentication; never logs credentials.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). Follow bounded provider continuation or pass continuation to fetch the next page. has_more reports an unconsumed continuation. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

Synthetic example inputs:

```json
{
  "organization": "sample-org"
}
```

definitions.documentation:
Get Build in the explicitly selected organization/project. Existing trigger/workflow pins and service hooks are unaffected. Actions require confirmWrites and no automatic retries.

GET /{organization}/{project}/_apis/build/builds/{buildId}. Read operation.

Inputs: organization (optional), project (optional), buildId (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, item, build_id, build_number, build_status, build_result. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://dev.azure.com), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: AZURE_DEVOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Project-scoped Azure DevOps PAT/OAuth permission for the selected API. Basic PAT authentication; never logs credentials.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

```json
{
  "organization": "sample-org",
  "project": "Synthetic Project",
  "buildId": 1
}
```

GET /{organization}/{project}/_apis/git/pullrequests/{pullRequestId}. Read operation.

Inputs: organization (optional), project (optional), pullRequestId (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Project-scoped Azure DevOps PAT/OAuth permission for the selected API. Basic PAT authentication; never logs credentials.

Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials.
